claims.evidence: Witness report shows two nearby lenses, but no readable lens model names/specs or focal lengths in the photo.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: No test shots/video playback, no close-up of lens glass, and no evidence of functionality (AF/buttons/shutter) in the witness report.
Witness report identifies the camera brand as Nikon (Nikon DSLR camera body visible).

risks.risk: Exact camera model is unknown; pricing depends heavily on the specific Nikon DSLR body (and whether it’s full-frame vs crop, older vs newer).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name and model number on the body (and/or the label in the battery compartment) plus a close-up of the lens mount area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified Nikon DSLR body with unknown specs and unknown condition.

risks.risk: Lens focal lengths/models (18-55mm and 50mm) are not confirmed; could be different lenses or non-matching/third-party variants.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lenses showing the printed focal length/model text (front ring and side barrel markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a Nikon DSLR with two unverified lenses of unknown quality.

risks.risk: Condition of lens glass (fungus, haze, scratches) is unknown; this can drastically reduce value.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of both lenses’ front and rear elements against light (and a photo of the glass at an angle).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lenses with unknown optical condition (worst-case: possible wear).

risks.risk: Camera functionality is untested (autofocus, buttons/dials, shutter, video).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing autofocus working and recording, plus a still photo test; also a photo of the rear screen showing a live view.

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history is unknown; higher wear lowers resale value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera menu or a shutter-count readout app (if available) showing shutter count.

risks.risk: Included accessories are incomplete/uncertain (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included, with each item visible (battery model, charger, memory card, lens caps/hoods).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body + lenses only, with missing accessories possible.

risks.risk: Brand mismatch risk: seller claims Canon, but witness reports Nikon—could indicate wrong listing or scam/misrepresentation.
risks.proof: Photo of the brand/model engraving on the camera body (front and top) and the lens mount branding.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as a misrepresented/uncertain item.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Nikon camera model and model number (including label in battery compartment).
Close-up photos of both lenses showing printed focal length/model text (18-55mm and 50mm confirmation).
Close-up photos of lens front and rear glass elements against light for fungus/haze/scratches.
Short test video clip (autofocus + recording) and a still photo sample from live view.
Photo/screenshot showing shutter count (or camera usage info).
A full accessories lay-out photo showing battery, charger, memory card, straps, and all caps/hoods included.
Photo of the camera brand engraving to resolve the Nikon vs Canon mismatch.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a Nikon DSLR body but the seller’s Canon claim conflicts, and key value drivers (exact model, lens models, optical condition, and functionality) are not verifiable from the single non-detailed photo. Without proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
